name: Yuuki Tsugumi
source:
The Yuuki family's second child. She is a brash, argumentative girl who firmly believes that if you yell enough, people will fall into line. She is the prime candidate to take over the position of Head Hostess.

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Come_See_Me_Tonight]Wikipedia[/url]]
